title: Layer 3 round 2 minor collector QE: falsifiability gaps on just-fixed surfaces — degenerate-budget hard-cuts, the config artifact cap, and both #782 surfaces (home fold, degraded-line shape) have no falsifier; plus the work-item-budget hardcode and the render-text hardcode-parallel nits

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff0d3a3f: falsifiers added for the surfaces round 1 fixed by inspection — a_degenerate_budget_hard_cuts (a budget-override lever drives the sub-mark-width branch, asserting within-budget and one line), the_config_read_refuses_an_oversize_file (a past-cap file is a diagnostic naming the breach), the_broken_form_folds_the_home_prefix (a path under HOME renders ~, account segment absent), and the_degraded_report_line_leads_with_the_next_step (position of next-step before the kind token). The human form now reads work-item and milestone absence text from the registered data set (one shared source, no silent drift); the generic-truncation test reads its budget from the data, not a literal. The remaining nit — the session absence and unregistered-kind fallback wordings — stays hardcoded by design: session is the demoted field with no registered display entry, and the fallback is a shared constant already, so neither has a registered source to drift from.
